initial_failed_attempt.cause: The private monitor repeatedly sent status/capture before receiving CAPTURE_BEGIN. The command queue overflow triggered ESP_ERROR_CHECK and reset.
initial_failed_attempt.resolution: Monitor sends the start commands once. Firmware rejects excess UART commands with COMMAND_BUSY instead of aborting.

privacy: Selected technical metadata and fixed test definitions only. Raw logs, actual UART port, serial numbers, MAC addresses and local paths are excluded.
